sajivana: Sajīvāna, (nt．) at S．I, 44 is metric spelling for sa-jīvana [sa2=saṁ, +jīvana] “same livelihood, ” in phrase kiṁsu kamme s．“what is (of) the same livelihood in work, i．e．occupation?” The form is the same as jīvāna at J．III, 353．Taken wrongly as Gen．pl．by Mrs．Rh．D．in trsln (K．S．I．63) : “who in their work is mate to sons of men?” following Bdhgh’s wrong interpretation (see K．S．I．321) as “kammena saha jīvantānan; kammadutiyakā nāma honti．” (Page 668)
